source.authorship_evidence_basis: Later verified Kalaignar anthology item correspondence (`kalaignar-song-023`); the materially different later-witness opening is not imported into this booklet's text.

source_tamil_lines: வானை நோக்கித் திரையைப் போட்டால் வட்ட நிலாவும்
english_lines: Leela!... Laali!... that's poli—phony!...
Girl born as daughter to a father without sight!
My dear, who told countless lies and even
Turned me around!
If a cat closes its eyes, will the whole world grow
Dark? Meow, meow!
If a curtain is hung up toward the sky, will even the round moon
Disappear? (Kan)
notes: The opening `லீலா / லாலீ / போலீ` sound-play is kept visible; `போலி` is glossed through `phony` without replacing the Tamil pun.
The source refrain cue `(கண்)` is retained as `(Kan)` rather than expanded.

english_lines: A clever fellow's lies and twists,
Last eight days—but this
Sugarcane bundle's lies and twists,
For how many days?... Ah! (Kan)
notes: The proverb-like `கெட்டிக்காரன்...எட்டு நாளைக்கு` construction is retained directly.
`கட்டிக் கரும்பு` is kept as the concrete sugarcane image rather than normalized to a generic term of affection.

source_tamil_lines: நான் ஒண்ணும் பொய் சொல்லலே எல்லாம் உண்மை தான்...
english_lines: I didn't tell any lie at all—everything is true...
O girl from the house next door to Harishchandra's!
In telling the truth so outrageously, who
On this earth can equal you, dear?
notes: The Harishchandra truthfulness reference and Raja's sarcasm are preserved rather than explained away.

english_lines: Rani: Raja!
Raja: Rani!
Rani: Ah!...(surprise)
notes: The source-visible dialogue turn labels remain visible inside this interleaved song/dialogue block.

source_tamil_lines: சீட்டுக் கட்டு ராணி போல சிக்கிவிட்டாய் பெண்மயிலே
கிளாவர் ராணி! உனக்கு என்ன வேணுமின்னு கேளு...
ஆட்டின் ராணிபோல ஆடு டைமன் ராணிபோல ஆடு
english_lines: Like the queen in a pack of cards, you've been caught, peahen,
We can live without distress, flower-cuckoo!
Queen of clubs! Ask for whatever you want...
Dance like the queen of the game; dance like the diamond queen,
Hey, queen of spades! Why this sorrow?
What anger do you have against me?
Is telling the truth the sin?
What yearning lies in your heart?
notes: The source's club/diamond/spade playing-card code-switching and Raja/Rani word-play are retained explicitly.
`ஆட்டின் ராணி` is rendered conservatively as `queen of the game`, preserving the card/play context.

translator_notes: Song 8 crosses PDF 7→8 and preserves the source's unusual interleaving of lyric and dialogue.
